correctness.rationale: The proof uses the exact cosine product law, one-dimensionality of the global kernel, invariant residue-pair sectors, Lemma 5.1 of arXiv:2609.38629v1, and an index-zero Fredholm surjectivity argument. The arithmetic equivalence \(E_{2r}^{(n)}=E_r^{(n)}\) if and only if \(3r\equiv0\pmod n\) for a nonzero residue pair is exact. The source Theorem 2.4 then yields pitchfork type. The finite enumeration through \(n=30\) is only corroborative.

value.rationale: The theorem gives a complete all-\(n\) classification of when one-dimensional cyclic symmetry can fail to force a pitchfork at quadratic order. It explains the source's \(n=3\) versus \(n=2,5\) behavior and identifies exactly which critical sectors still need transcritical verification, making the result structurally useful rather than a routine parameter substitution.
